**Technical Approach:**
- Utilizes a deep learning framework incorporating both spatial and temporal features.
- Employs a semantic-supervised learning approach to improve detection accuracy.
- Integrates multi-source data for comprehensive feature extraction.

**Quantitative Findings:**
- Achieved a detection accuracy of 92.5% on the benchmark dataset.
